tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background, the default paper surface behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Sidebar, topbar and recessed panels (e.g. inline task rows).

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover/active row fill and table stripes.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Floating voice-command panel and macOS notification body — one step lighter than the page so it reads as raised paper, not a modal.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline borders on cards, rows and dividers.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Panel outline while recording/processing, and focus-visible outlines (paired with the focus ring token).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icon fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, breadcrumbs, timestamps, placeholder copy.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and the lightest captions.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Recording indicator, active nav item, primary action text — the one warm accent in the system, used sparingly.

tokens.name: accent-on
tokens.usage: Text/icons placed on top of the accent color.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Confirmation text (e.g. 'Opened: …'). Always paired with a ✓ glyph, never color alone.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Overdue/late metadata text. Always paired with a word ('late'), never color alone.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Unavailable/error state text and icon fill.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Drop shadow under the floating voice panel and the macOS notification card.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Barely-there dimming wash directly under the voice panel so it separates from busy content without a modal backdrop.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon-to-glyph spacing.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tight gaps within a row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Row internal padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside the app content column.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Panel offset from the bottom edge of the viewport.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, buttons, notification card.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The floating voice-command panel.
